00.name: Lumberjack
00.text: Okay. So which way is north.

01.name: Sour
01.text: Well north is whatever way your facing.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: No... that's... just wrong. Let's just follow the trail out of the forest.

03.name: Narrator
03.text: You follow the trail for what seems like an age before coming up to a split in the trail. One trail bends to the left the other towards the right.

04.name: Lumberjack
04.text: What way do we go now?

06.name: Sweat
06.text: No we have to go right.

08.name: Sweat
08.text: What are you stupid. Everyone knows that going right is always the right way to go.

09.name: Sour
09.text: Nun uh. Left is the way to go cause left is the best.

10.name: Sweat
10.text: This isn't getting us anywhere. Mortal you decide, should we go left or right. I know your smart enough to realise that we need to go right.

11.name: Sour
11.text: Don't listen to that green orb, let's go left.
